system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Guile and Insight, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Gambling Lore, Lore of a particular game, Gaming Houses Lore.
system.description: You earned your living across a gaming table, where confidence could be worth more than a winning hand. You learned when to press someone and when to gather your winnings quietly.
